entities.name: Ikra Shidiqi
entities.description: A cunning naga of Tarkir's past, advisor to Tasigur who betrayed him and became Silumgar's first dragonspeaker.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: The khan of the Sultai Brood, overthrown by Silumgar.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragon whose forces overthrew Tasigur and took control of the Sultai Brood.

entities.name: Sultai Brood
entities.description: The brood Silumgar took control of.

events.summary: After Tasigur offends the rakshasa Khudal, Shidiqi abandons him and joins Silumgar's forces as they overthrow Tasigur and take control of the Sultai Brood.
events.quote: the naga quickly abandoned her master

relations.note: She served as an advisor to the khan Tasigur for many years.
relations.quote: served as an advisor to the khan Tasigur for many years
